proposal.summary: The CI unit job would include the existing package test suite alongside its TypeScript syntax check, providing automated behavioral evidence for the documented catalog invariants on pushes and pull requests. Validation scope covers expected behavior and CI failure propagation; restoring the prior job configuration is the rollback.
proposal.title: CI behavioral test coverage

summary: The CI unit job is configured for syntax checking while the package exposes a test script covering valid input, duplicates, negative stock, and fractional stock, and repository guidance requires focused behavior checks. Integrating that suite would reduce the risk of behavioral regressions reaching merge without automated CI evidence.
unverifiedChecks: Whether the package test suite is compatible with the CI environment remains unverified.
Whether test failures are reported as CI failures remains unverified.
